title.narrative: Danida Sustainable Infrastructure Finance - Ghana - Lavender Hill Sludge Treatment Project

description.narrative: The project will provide an effective low-cost faecal sludge treatment plant at "Lavender Hill" in Accra Metropolitan Area. The project will provice an efficient and well-proven technological treatment plant solution, it addresses an apparent need, and will upgrade the negligible Waste management infrastructure existing in Accra.
